product narrative / description: GLANZA Premium Wall Putty (40kg) is a white cement-based premium putty formulated with imported polymers and reinforcing fillers for interior and exterior walls. Provides velvety smooth finish, fills minor cracks, protects against heavy rain, dampness, and flaking. Coverage: 400-600 sq.ft per 40kg bag (2 coats). Features QR code for instant painter loyalty rewards.

GP Paints Elegant Sparkling White Wash (40kg) is an advanced polymer-modified waterproof formulation for concrete and cement walls (interior & exterior). Delivers a brilliant sparkling white finish with zero brush marks, anti-fungus, and anti-algae protection. Coverage: 25-30 sq.ft/kg (2 coats). Features Scan & Earn QR loyalty rewards.
